headline: Indian Shares Open Lower as Hawkish Fed Minutes Weigh on Sentiment
summary: Indian benchmark indexes were set to open lower as a hawkish tone from the US Federal Reserve's meeting minutes outweighed support from easing crude oil prices and foreign fund inflows.
why: Expectations regarding US monetary policy heavily influence foreign institutional capital flows and risk sentiment across emerging equity markets like India.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: Hawkish Federal Reserve signals drive risk-off sentiment, causing domestic equity futures to point lower.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A hawkish stance in the latest US Federal Reserve meeting minutes dampened investor sentiment, overshadowing local equity inflows and lower crude oil prices.
